headline: Every sector falls on Anthropic's big day
context: An early rally faded after Anthropic's stock market debut, and selling spread across the market as investors cooled on AI stocks.

winners.name: Palo Alto Networks
winners.why: Results beat forecasts: profit per share of $1.05 vs $0.97 expected. It also raised its full-year sales forecast.

winners.name: Okta, Inc.
winners.why: No company news. Security stocks rallied for a second day, lifted by Palo Alto's higher forecast.

winners.name: Everpure
winners.why: The data storage firm's results beat forecasts, with profit per share $0.08 above estimates. It also raised its yearly sales forecast.

losers.name: Williams-Sonoma, Inc.
losers.why: Profit only just beat forecasts, sales fell slightly short, and it kept its yearly forecast unchanged.

losers.name: Twilio
losers.why: No company news. It fell with the wider tech sell-off, as software peers Microsoft and ServiceNow also dropped.

losers.name: Advanced Micro Devices
losers.why: Fell after Hunterbrook, which bets against it, claimed its chips reached a blacklisted Chinese firm.
